field_principles.action_ranking_rows: Pairwise rows give half credit to ties and preserve the primary statistic.
field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: An independent row reduction detects aggregate drift.
field_principles.arm_definition_rows: Explicit policies prevent controls from changing after outcomes are seen.
field_principles.belief_future_utility_positive_score: One requires prospective ranking value beyond both controls.
field_principles.belief_utility_comparison_complete_score: One means all planned comparison rows are present and consistent.
field_principles.capacity_match_rows: Equal slot limits make recency a fair bounded-memory control.
field_principles.cited_upstream_artifacts: Field citations identify which prior claims the comparison imports.
field_principles.confidence_intervals: Decision-cluster intervals avoid treating candidate pairs as independent.
field_principles.contradiction_avoidance_rows: Selection rows show how often an arm chooses contradicted evidence.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time proves that the comparison command ran.
field_principles.field_principles: A principle for each field makes the evidence contract reviewable.
field_principles.frozen_split: A pre-sidecar protocol prevents target-driven split or metric changes.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: The first failed check gives downstream readers an exact terminal reason.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A class-consistent prefix prevents storage safety from becoming a utility claim.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate states that deterministic rows, not an LLM, make rankings.
field_principles.leakage_check_rows: Leakage receipts prove current and sealed outcomes do not enter rankings.
field_principles.no_headroom_rows: No-headroom rows prevent a null target contrast from counting as failure.
field_principles.paired_delta_rows: Matched deltas compare belief with each control on the same decisions.
field_principles.per_decision_results: Decision rows prove that each ranking used only earlier evidence.
field_principles.per_mechanic_results: Mechanic rows show whether one group alone drives a pooled result.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Exact gates stop changed or insufficient evidence before scoring.
field_principles.query_cost_rows: Per-unit bytes and time expose the cost of each memory policy.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed makes the cluster bootstrap reproducible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A timing-free digest detects deterministic artifact drift.
field_principles.retention_rows: Retention rows test whether protected construction facts survive later traffic.
field_principles.rows: Arm aggregates expose the primary and secondary results without hiding units.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Content hashes bind every imported claim to exact bytes.
field_principles.unsupported_rows: Unsupported rows expose decisions that lack two logged candidates.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class separates a positive result from a complete null.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False states that no outcome oracle creates a policy ranking.
